# Backyard Garden and Compost Log

This log tracks soil amendments, watering schedules, and compost bin turnover for the three raised cedar beds behind the patio.

## Watering Schedule

Drip irrigation lines run automatically at 05:30 for twenty minutes on Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday mornings during dry months. Overhead hand watering of tomato and chili seedlings should finish before 08:00 so wet foliage dries quickly in morning sun and avoids powdery mildew spots.

## Compost Bay Turnover

Mix two buckets of shredded dry leaves or cardboard strips for every bucket of kitchen vegetable scraps to maintain a balanced carbon-to-nitrogen ratio. Turn the active compost pile with a pitchfork every seven days and check that the core temperature stays warm between 50 and 60 degrees Celsius without smelling sour or anaerobic.

## Soil pH and Harvest Notes

Raised bed number two tested at pH 6.4 in February after mixing two kilograms of dolomitic limestone and screened worm castings into the top fifteen centimeters. Cherry tomato transplants spaced sixty centimeters apart yielded best when pruned to two main stems and mulched with clean rice straw.
